AC.bandwidth: first downward magnitude crossing of |H(1 kHz)|/sqrt(2), magnitude interpolation in log frequency; no crossing is explicit
AC.gain: signed real at 1 kHz; band magnitude within 5.4–6.6 over every recorded frequency 1–100 kHz
AC.reference: complex V(out)/V(in), external ideal voltage port before Rsrc

DC: Vout minus fixed 0.5 V; signed error, mean absolute error, RMS error and sample SD kept distinct.
historical: Original v1.1/v1.2 measurements remain distinct; this study never overwrites their evaluations.

noise.method: Trapezoidal integration with interpolated endpoints; frequency-by-frequency referral S_out/|Vout/Vin|^2, gain-squared interpolated in log frequency.
noise.quantity: PSD V^2/Hz verified with set sqrnoise and A resistor/RC check
noise.scope: Nominal designs only, no Local noise statistics
noise.sources: BSIM and all resistor noise, including source and external load; ideal voltage sources add no noise.

numerical: ngspice47 Sparse, one thread, -n with pinned system spinit, reltol1e-7/abstol1e-15/vntol1e-9, native gm/gds and actual DELVTO/MULU0/W/L/m/nf before and after every analysis; finite shapes/axes/endpoints plus KCL and supported terminal pairs. Numerical usability separate from every specification outcome.
refinement: Two representative unchanged physical nominal circuits: double frequency density and halve tmax, reltol1e-8; all reported scalar changes <0.005 relative, center <1uV. A validated analytic/edge/censoring fixtures retained.
resources: DC delivered current sum max(0,-I(Vdd))+max(0,-I(Vin)); port power sum -V*I using each actual voltage. Sine period-average net currents and integrated port power separate. Zero-V sensors not counted twice. All internal reference/load/bias/passives counted; common external source/load dependencies explicit.

sine.initial: ordinary DC operating-point initialization; no UIC
sine.limits: THD <= 2%, fundamental gain within 10% of 6, actual output within [0.25,0.75] V. No tail recentering.
sine.stationary: Last two resampled cycles differ by < max(100 nV, fundamental_peak*1e-4)
sine.subset: first four frozen indices at nominal; other samples have no dynamic compliance claim

step.band: 1% of separately solved stationary output difference; last outside/first inside bracket with no observed later re-exit; not accuracy recentering
